description:
U by Urbeo is proud to present UHX,  a brand-new residential development ideally located in the heart of Harold’s Cross.

Key Features:

- Resident App for
- A-rated energy efficient apartments offering year-round comfort
- Generous storage throughout all apartment types
- Fully fitted kitchens with dishwasher, integrated appliances and induction cooking
- High-end Danish and Italian joinery by MJF Interiors
- Spacious, well-designed layouts suited to modern living
- Basement car parking and bike storage
- Bringme Parcel management lockers for convenient delivery whilst you’re away from home

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
